method: Instrumented own kit.furnish call boundary around unchanged production ZoneBase.buildHall; captured precisely objects/colliders created inside furnishRoom, not material/bounding-box guesses

inventoryDecision.basis: Actual runtime invokes generic dimension-based preset with no room-specific inventory/profile. Existing canonical AUX binding has no attached room image/current furniture evidence. This is a gap in available project evidence, not proof that sources do not exist publicly.
withdraw: exact meshes created by unchanged furnishRoom call
only their exact self-owned collision boxes
their room cover points
